glosses: Faire entrer une association dans un groupement.

examples.text: Affilier plusieurs sociétés à une société centrale.
L’Académie française avait affilié quelques académies de province.

glosses: Entrer dans un groupement, une association.

examples.text: S’affilier à une congrégation, à une société, à un complot.
Toutes les autres catégories de travailleurs, sans distinction d'aucune sorte, devraient bénéficier du droit de constituer les organisations de leur choix et de s'y affilier.

glosses: Someone or something, especially, a television station, that is associated with a larger, related organization, such as a television network; a member of a group of associated things.

examples.text: Our local TV channel is an affiliate of NBC.
They used to been^([sic]) more of a Detroit channel, as they had showed a lot of American programs, aside from being the CBC affiliate.

glosses: To adopt; to receive into a family as one's offspring
to bring or receive into close connection; to ally.

examples.text: Is the soul affiliated to God, or is it estranged and in rebellion?
to affiliate the child to (or on or upon) one man rather than another

glosses: To connect in the way of descent; to trace origin to.

examples.text: How do these facts tend to affiliate the faculty of hearing upon the aboriginal vegetative processes?

glosses: To attach (to) or unite (with); to receive into a society as a member, and initiate into its mysteries, plans, etc.
Inscribir, asociar a una persona en una organización, asociación o grupo.
